===
sloplint: comma list of bare words in a pipeline command
===

Get-Module Pester.Runtime, Pester | Remove-Module

---

(program
  (statement_list
    (pipeline
      (pipeline_chain
        (command
          (command_name)
          (command_elements
            (command_argument_sep)
            (array_literal_expression
              (generic_token)
              (generic_token))
            (command_argument_sep)))
        (command
          (command_name))))))

                  (unary_expression
                    (variable)))
                (command_argument_sep)

                (command_parameter)
                (command_argument_sep)

    (function_statement
      (function_name)
      (script_block

                  (type_name
                    (type_identifier))))))
          (parameter_list
            (script_parameter
              (attribute_list
                (attribute
                  (type_literal
                    (type_spec
                      (type_name
                        (type_identifier))))))
              (variable))))
        (script_block_body
          (statement_list
            (pipeline
              (pipeline_chain
                (logical_expression
                  (bitwise_expression
                    (comparison_expression
                      (additive_expression
                        (multiplicative_expression
                          (format_expression
                            (range_expression
                              (array_literal_expression
                                (unary_expression
                                  (string_literal
                                    (verbatim_string_characters)))))))))))))))))
    (function_statement
      (function_name)
      (script_block
        (param_block
          (parameter_list
            (script_parameter
              (variable))))

          (statement_list
            (pipeline
              (pipeline_chain

                    (command_argument_sep)
